description:
FOUND s513h (Opus, perf round 44, 2026-10-09) profiling `localvar` (`sub lv { local $g = $_[0]; $g + 1 }`, 2 M calls) on
main f762553c: about-to-modify-symbol-value + get-info-value + packed-info-value-index ~30 % of the run.  SBCL compiles
`(setf (sb-ext:symbol-global-value 'X) v)` -- even for a quoted symbol, even at safety 0 -- to a full call of
SB-KERNEL:SET-SYMBOL-GLOBAL-VALUE, which checks the info database before %SET-SYMBOL-GLOBAL-VALUE.  A p-defcell symbol is
never a constant and never typed, so the check cannot fire.

=== DONE (s513h) === %p-cell-set (a macro = sb-kernel:%set-symbol-global-value, an EXPORTED sb-kernel symbol) at the
eight macro-emitted cell writes: p-local-cell (install + restore), p-local-cell-if (install + restore), the two foreach
expanders over a global loop variable (per iteration + restore).  p-defcell's one-time init keeps the public setf.
Emission text unchanged.  Hand-replaced A/B (ab-m2.log): localvar -28.1 % (control <= 1.3 %).  Core A/B
(bench-m2.log, control <= 1.1 %): localvar -27.1 %, `our $x; for $x (1..3e6)` -38.1 %.  Probe table sprobe.pl (26
rows: local after die / return / last / recursion, local elem / array / hash elem, ref to the old box, unbound global,
foreach global restored / seen by a sub / after die, local if, @_ alias / copy, &sub, goto &sub, depth 10000,
wantarray, 0/1/1000 args, passarr) base == tree; perl == tree except caller(0)[5] (pre-existing, #233's family).
Guard Pl/t/perf-levers-13.t rows 6-9 (6 inverse-verified).
subject: PERF (s513h, DONE): `local $g` on a cell global wrote the cell through SET-SYMBOL-GLOBAL-VALUE, which asks the info database (constant? declared type?) on every write -- ~30 % of localvar; also every iteration of a foreach over a global loop variable
